claim: On every parameter of the pre-existing nonempty carrier-open locus, all 28 P12--P16 cusp classes are semiample. Twenty-seven move primitively and F=4H-E1-...-E16 has exact semiample index four. There is no additional cusp-specific exceptional parameter polynomial: two explicit ZZ[a] rank/section charts have coprime gates in every nontrivial case.

proof_logic.connected_genus_nine_fibre: on a rational surface the Stein base has genus zero; h0(4F)=2 forces the finite Stein degree to be one, and adjunction gives arithmetic genus nine
proof_logic.last_cusp: constant nonzero maximal minors give h0(F)=h0(2F)=h0(3F)=1 for every parameter; two coprime fourth-multiple charts give h0(4F)=2 and a base-point-free pencil for every parameter
proof_logic.new_five: coefficientwise ZZ[a] jet kernels provide two exact charts; their gate gcd is one, and in each valid chart the second member has exact cluster multiplicities and is coprime to every irreducible wall factor
proof_logic.old_22: the 16 multi-affine-component pencils, five line pencils, and P13 quartic pencil use parameter-independent wall cycles and apply throughout the carrier-open locus

scope.base_locus: the carrier-open subset from the non-isotrivial family theorem, where C_a,Q_a,S_a are geometrically integral and the complete nef chambers P12--P16 persist
